'''Ukanaku ''' was a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive nest on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Daria Thul]] became a [[Joiner]] in the nest.<ref name="TOR" />
